LAREDO, Texas — Laredo Medical Center is inviting the community to its Frontline Family Fest on Saturday, Oct. 24, a free event running 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. to honor the area’s first responders, according to KGNS.

The fest, held at the Buena Vista Emergency Room, 4019 Cuatro Vientos, recognizes firefighters, police officers and local and federal law enforcement officers serving the region. Families can meet first responders face to face and see emergency trucks and patrol cars up close.

The lineup includes Halloween costumes, a mascot dance-off, food and family activities — a day built around thanking the people who answer the calls.

Sources: KGNS reporting by A.J. Juarez (Oct. 22, 2026).

title: Laredo Medical Center hosts Frontline Family Fest honoring first responders Saturday
